_meta.notice: DEMO CONTENT — Sample questions only. Not official previous-year papers.

lang.en: Fill in the blank: ___ Taj Mahal is in Agra.
lang.hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: ___ Taj Mahal is in Agra.

explanation.en: 'The' is used before specific, unique nouns (definite article). Taj Mahal is a unique monument.
explanation.hi: विशिष्ट और अद्वितीय संज्ञाओं से पहले 'The' का प्रयोग होता है। Taj Mahal एक अद्वितीय स्मारक है।

explanation.en: For third person singular (She/He/It) in Simple Present, we add 's' to the verb: 'goes'.
explanation.hi: तृतीय पुरुष एकवचन (She/He/It) के लिए Simple Present में क्रिया में 's' लगाते हैं: 'goes'।

explanation.en: 'Joyful' means very happy — it is the closest synonym to 'Happy'.
explanation.hi: 'Joyful' का अर्थ बहुत प्रसन्न है — यह 'Happy' का सबसे करीबी पर्यायवाची है।

explanation.en: 'Ancient' means very old; its antonym is 'Modern' (recent/new).
explanation.hi: 'Ancient' का अर्थ बहुत पुराना है; इसका विलोम 'Modern' (आधुनिक) है।

explanation.en: 'On' is used for surfaces. The book is ON the table (resting on its surface).
explanation.hi: 'On' का प्रयोग सतहों के लिए होता है। पुस्तक मेज की सतह पर है।

explanation.en: 'Yesterday' indicates past tense. Simple Past of 'watch' = 'watched'.
explanation.hi: 'Yesterday' अतीत को दर्शाता है। 'watch' का Simple Past = 'watched'।

lang.en: Find the error: 'He don't know the answer.'
lang.hi: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'He don't know the answer.'

explanation.en: 'He' is 3rd person singular, so the correct auxiliary is 'doesn't' (not 'don't'). Correct: 'He doesn't know the answer.'
explanation.hi: 'He' तृतीय पुरुष एकवचन है, इसलिए सही सहायक क्रिया 'doesn't' है। सही: 'He doesn't know the answer.'

explanation.en: 'Courageous' is the best synonym for 'Brave'.
explanation.hi: 'Courageous' 'Brave' का सबसे अच्छा पर्यायवाची है।

lang.en: By next year, I ___ my degree.
lang.hi: By next year, I ___ my degree.

explanation.en: 'By next year' signals Future Perfect Tense: 'will have completed'.
explanation.hi: 'By next year' Future Perfect Tense को दर्शाता है: 'will have completed'।

explanation.en: 'Transparent' means you can see through; 'Opaque' means you cannot — they are antonyms.
explanation.hi: 'Transparent' का अर्थ पारदर्शी; 'Opaque' का अर्थ अपारदर्शी — ये विलोम हैं।

lang.hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ है:

explanation.en: 'Beat around the bush' means to avoid talking about the main subject or to be indirect.
explanation.hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ है मुख्य विषय से बचना या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से बोलना।

lang.en: ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.
lang.hi: ___ apple a day keeps the doctor away.

explanation.en: 'An' is used before words starting with a vowel sound. 'Apple' starts with the vowel 'A'.
explanation.hi: स्वर ध्वनि से शुरू होने वाले शब्दों से पहले 'An' का प्रयोग होता है। 'Apple' स्वर 'A' से शुरू होता है।

lang.en: Correct the sentence: 'I am knowing the answer.'
lang.hi: वाक्य सुधारें: 'I am knowing the answer.'

explanation.en: 'Know' is a stative verb; it doesn't take continuous form. Correct: 'I know the answer.'
explanation.hi: 'Know' एक स्थैतिक क्रिया है; यह Continuous form नहीं लेती। सही: 'I know the answer.'

explanation.en: 'Abundant' means more than enough; 'Plentiful' is its synonym.
explanation.hi: 'Abundant' का अर्थ प्रचुर मात्रा में; 'Plentiful' इसका पर्यायवाची है।

lang.en: She was tired, ___ she continued working.
lang.hi: She was tired, ___ she continued working.

explanation.en: 'But' shows contrast between two clauses. Despite being tired, she continued — this is a contrast.
explanation.hi: 'But' दो उपवाक्यों के बीच विरोध दर्शाता है। थकी होने के बावजूद काम करती रही — यह विरोध है।

explanation.en: 'Generous' means giving freely; 'Miserly' (or stingy) means unwilling to give — the antonym.
explanation.hi: 'Generous' का अर्थ उदार; 'Miserly' का अर्थ कंजूस — ये विलोम हैं।

lang.hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ है:

explanation.en: 'Once in a blue moon' means something that happens very rarely.
explanation.hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ है कभी-कभार होने वाली घटना।

explanation.en: 'Since' is used with a specific point in time (2010). 'For' is used with a duration (5 years).
explanation.hi: 'Since' का प्रयोग विशिष्ट समय बिंदु (2010) के साथ होता है। 'For' अवधि (5 years) के साथ।

lang.en: One who cannot read and write is called:
lang.hi: जो पढ़-लिख नहीं सकता उसे क्या कहते हैं?

explanation.en: An 'Illiterate' person is one who cannot read and write.
explanation.hi: 'Illiterate' वह व्यक्ति है जो पढ़-लिख नहीं सकता।

lang.en: Change to passive: 'Ram ate the apple.'
lang.hi: Passive voice में बदलें: 'Ram ate the apple.'

en: The apple is eaten by Ram.
The apple was eaten by Ram.
The apple has been eaten by Ram.
hi: The apple is eaten by Ram.
The apple was eaten by Ram.
The apple has been eaten by Ram.

explanation.en: Active: Ram (subject) ate (past) apple. Passive: The apple was eaten by Ram. (Past Passive = was/were + past participle)
explanation.hi: Active: Ram ने apple खाई। Passive: The apple was eaten by Ram. (Past Passive = was/were + past participle)

lang.en: Correct: 'Neither of the boys have done their homework.'
lang.hi: सुधारें: 'Neither of the boys have done their homework.'

en: Neither of the boys have done their homework.
Neither of the boys has done his homework.
Neither of the boys are doing their homework.
hi: Neither of the boys have done their homework.
Neither of the boys has done his homework.
Neither of the boys are doing their homework.

explanation.en: 'Neither' takes singular verb and pronoun: 'Neither of the boys has done his homework.'
explanation.hi: 'Neither' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया लगती है: 'Neither of the boys has done his homework.'

explanation.en: 'Eloquent' means speaking in a fluent and persuasive way; 'Fluent' is its synonym.
explanation.hi: 'Eloquent' का अर्थ प्रवाहपूर्ण और प्रभावशाली बोलना; 'Fluent' इसका पर्यायवाची है।

explanation.en: 'At' is used with specific times. The train arrives AT 6 o'clock.
explanation.hi: 'At' का प्रयोग विशिष्ट समय के साथ होता है।

explanation.en: 'Break the ice' means to initiate conversation in an awkward or tense situation.
explanation.hi: 'Break the ice' का अर्थ है अजीब या तनावपूर्ण स्थिति में बातचीत शुरू करना।

explanation.en: 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound /ɒ/ (the 'h' is silent), so 'an' is used.
explanation.hi: 'Honest' में 'h' मूक है और यह स्वर ध्वनि /ɒ/ से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an' का प्रयोग।

explanation.en: 'Optimistic' means hopeful; 'Pessimistic' means expecting the worst — they are antonyms.
explanation.hi: 'Optimistic' का अर्थ आशावादी; 'Pessimistic' का अर्थ निराशावादी — ये विलोम हैं।

lang.en: By the time we arrived, the show ___.
lang.hi: By the time we arrived, the show ___.

explanation.en: Past Perfect (had + V3) is used for an action completed before another past action. The show had started before we arrived.
explanation.hi: Past Perfect (had + V3) का प्रयोग तब होता है जब एक क्रिया दूसरी भूत क्रिया से पहले हुई हो।

lang.en: One who studies the stars and planets is called:
lang.hi: तारों और ग्रहों का अध्ययन करने वाले को क्या कहते हैं?

explanation.en: An 'Astronomer' studies stars, planets, and other celestial bodies scientifically.
explanation.hi: 'Astronomer' वैज्ञानिक रूप से तारों, ग्रहों और अन्य खगोलीय पिंडों का अध्ययन करता है।

lang.en: ___ you study hard, you will not pass.
lang.hi: ___ you study hard, you will not pass.

explanation.en: 'Unless' means 'if not' — 'Unless you study hard (= if you do not study hard), you will not pass.'
explanation.hi: 'Unless' का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' — 'यदि मेहनत नहीं करोगे, तो पास नहीं होगे।'

en: She is more smarter than him.
She is most smart than him.
She is more smart than him.
hi: She is more smarter than him.
She is most smart than him.
She is more smart than him.

explanation.en: 'Smart' is a one-syllable adjective. Its comparative form is 'smarter' (not 'more smarter'). Correct: 'She is smarter than him.'
explanation.hi: 'Smart' एकल-अक्षर विशेषण है। इसका तुलनात्मक रूप 'smarter' है।
